---
title: "Percentage of the population aged 65 and over by canton in Luxembourg"
output:
  html_document:
    self_contained: true
    theme: flatly
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE
)

library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(RCurl)
library(leaflet)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(htmltools)
```

```{r}

# Données STATEC
df_ratio1_tf <- read.csv(
  text = getURL(
    "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MathieuScheffer/Projet-Hackaton/Resources/df_ratio1_tf.csv"
  )
)

# Import des cantons du Luxembourg depuis le GeoJSON officiel
lu_sf <- sf::st_read(
  "https://download.data.public.lu/resources/cantons-in-luxembourg-2026/20260121-020309/cantons-lux-2026.geojson",
  quiet = TRUE
)

# Renommage des cantons pour correspondre aux labels STATEC
lu_sf$name <- dplyr::recode(
  lu_sf$name,
  "Clervaux" = "Canton Clervaux",
  "Diekirch" = "Canton Diekirch",
  "Redange" = "Canton Redange",
  "Vianden" = "Canton Vianden",
  "Wiltz" = "Canton Wiltz",
  "Echternach" = "Canton Echternach",
  "Grevenmacher" = "Canton Grevenmacher",
  "Remich" = "Canton Remich",
  "Capellen" = "Canton Capellen",
  "Esch-sur-Alzette" = "Canton Esch",
  "Luxembourg" = "Canton Luxembourg",
  "Mersch" = "Canton Mersch"
)

# Jointure avec les données STATEC
lu_sf_ratio1 <- lu_sf %>%
  left_join(
    df_ratio1_tf,
    by = c("name" = "geo_name_fr")
  )


pal <- colorNumeric(
  palette = RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, "Reds")[3:9],
  domain = lu_sf_ratio1$pct_65_plus,
  na.color = "transparent"
)

lu_sf_ratio1$popup <- paste0(
  "<strong>", lu_sf_ratio1$name, "</strong><br/>",
  "65 years and more : ",
  ifelse(
    is.na(lu_sf_ratio1$pct_65_plus),
    "NA",
    paste0(
      round(lu_sf_ratio1$pct_65_plus, 1),
      "%"
    )
  )
)

leaflet(lu_sf_ratio1) %>%
  addProviderTiles(
    providers$CartoDB.Positron
  ) %>%
  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~pal(pct_65_plus),
    weight = 1,
    color = "white",
    fillOpacity = 0.8,
    highlight = highlightOptions(
      weight = 2,
      color = "#666",
      bringToFront = TRUE
    ),
    label = lapply(
      lu_sf_ratio1$popup,
      HTML
    )
  ) %>%
  addLegend(
    "bottomright",
    pal = pal,
    values = ~pct_65_plus,
    title = "% 65 years and more",
    labFormat = labelFormat(
      suffix = "%"
    ),
    opacity = 0.9
  )


```
